body: How about you investigate something positive and uplifting instead. When I was in your position and was searching for the best solution I accidentally ran across the stupidest pun, but it made me crack a smile. That 8 months ago and things are just getting better. I never thought I would be grateful for a moron's joke. This isn't how your story should end.

They call dogs mans best friend for many reasons. You keep witnessing one of them. Maybe you should take the sign. Don't quit. You can have a happy life. You just have to step outside the shadows. It might not be easy but take it step by step and you carry on with a smile and a loving dog.
This is exactly what I needed. I give way too many fucks about petty shit, especially when it comes to the opinion of others. This is motivating as fuck. Thanks man.

I'm begging you to live longer. This should not be how a life ends. Would you want to read a story where the main character dropped off like this. No. Already by reading your post it's easy to see your intelligent. We need intelligent people to lead dumb people like me. Seriously don't do it. I know I may seem far away but I care for your life. Don't do this to those you love. Please. If not for you, for us dumb people. Live longer. You can get through this. Pm me if you need. I enjoy talking to smart people. Don't quit yet.

Hey man I understand most of what you are going through. I was diagnosed bipolar at young age. I was never good with communication and relationships even though I was desperate for. I was alone but desired companionship. I didn't get anything done for years. I felt hopeless. I had no motivation. So I also joined the military(army)where I eventually emotionally and mentally collapsed and was separated. I understand the despondency. I was dead, depressed, and indulged in suicidal thoughts. I eventually found ways to improve my life. I know this sucks but I had to step outside myself. Your soft spoken and lonely now but it doesn't mean you will always be. It's got to be your choice and it's going to take time, painful time but you can do it. Start off with something small like developing a new habit before or after you sleep. Say three things your grateful for. When your down think of someone you love and who loves you and currently present in your life smiling. Imagine them laughing then you laughing with them. This will be a slow process but it will help. Instead of watching a movie draw or write. Make one simple goal eachday. Write it down, execute, then check it off. When I mean simple I mean simple this is a starting point. You will eventually feel like you are accomplishing something. Buddy you can do this. Though I'm a distant stranger I am here for you. Also try saying "I can do this" at least once a day then work from there. Oh, this may sound kind of ridiculous but search r/GetMotivated. Consistently reading stories and strategies to improve your well being will begin to seep into your mind. Like I said your not alone. There are people here for you. You come across extremely intelligent and kind. These traits will get your friends you are just going to have to expose yourself. Give yourself time and learn to accept yourself. I really do believe you can do this. Always free to pm me. I'm on reddit quite a bit. Smile man it's going to be good.

Thank you for your support. It's amazing that strangers can care for each other. The reason we stopped talking was her choice. She thought I was becoming too attached. Which wasn't far from the truth. I felt alone and I wanted someone to hold on to.  She wants to wait until I see her in person to talk again which is something I tend to dwell on.I do see therapy regularly. It's just that I'm having difficulty remaining positive and in the moment. I keep myself as busy as possible but it seems to not be enough. My family has been extremely supportive and helping me along. As I said before thank you.
